Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present, with the value `true`, ONLY when this answer is the stored replay of an earlier request that used the same `Idempotency-Key` (the handler did not run again). The first execution never carries it.

schema.description: Acknowledgement of an accepted work delegation (ADR-0058): the work unit Work Planning admitted for the path. The WorkReleased event on Kafka remains the authoritative fact.

workUnitId.description: The work unit Work Planning admitted.

cpt.description: The admitted unit's common pick time.
